title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Blue Balloons
A young couple comes to jail after a crime spree, but their stories don't add up; one of the jail's most prolific contraband smugglers makes her return, but staff cracks down on the pipeline.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Killing Clouds
An online post from a diehard Dodgers fan leads to his arrest at a Reds game; a tragic shooting leaves one inmate facing prison time and outrage over his punishment leads to more arrests.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Pros and Cons
A low-level offender increases his sentence from 18 months to 16-and-a-half years after three separate counts of aggravated battery on an officer; the same inmate was banned from even non-contact visits after an affair with a prison staff nurse.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Fight or Flight
The Penitentiary of New Mexico houses both low level and max-security inmates; Level 6 inmates like Chris Shiverdecker, who has a MacGyver-like prison reputation, are still eligible for hearings that could change custody level and security status.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Institutionalized
Inmates who become disruptive at the Penitentiary of New Mexico are transferred to the lock-up units in level 5 or 6; the trouble is, their behavior doesn't always improve; this is a lesson rookie officer Amy Lee is learning the hard way.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Miss Fortune
A troubled young inmate, recently sentenced to prison, attempts to make a final impression on staff; a young woman who gave birth in the jail watches her baby grow up without her.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Next of Kin
The jail responds with force after an officer is assaulted and inmates attempt escape; an 18-year-old shoots her father to death then finds a surrogate mother on the inside.

title: Lockup: Tampa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — The Company You Keep
An inmate with suspicious tax forms becomes a problem for the jail, and a murder ends with the victim burned alive in a dumpster, pitting friends and family against each other.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S6 E3 — Rock Bottom
Addiction leads prisoners to serious crime to fuel their habits.

S1 E4 — Killing Clouds
An online post from a diehard Dodgers fan leads to his arrest at a Reds game; a tragic shooting leaves one inmate facing prison time and outrage over his punishment leads to more arrests.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — The Hustle
Prison is an underground economy, where some deals are signed in ink and others are signed in blood; a rare look at the schemes, hustles and extortions conducted behind prison walls and the consequences they carry.

title: Lockup
description:
S2 E11 — Tennessee Women's Prison
Inmates at Tennessee Prison For Women gain career skills by taking part in a cosmetology program.

title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — The Confession
Inside the Orange County Jail a senior inmate takes up rap; a gang member poses a threat; another inmate makes the most shocking confession ever heard on Lockup.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — War
Prison officials initiate a shakedown after gang members in Level 6 overpower an officer in the recreation area, take her keys and stab a rival gang member; this type of incident simply adds to the tension already felt in the supermax facility.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Get Out and Stay Out
For some inmates, the only way out of prison is "paroling legit," or leaving in a body bag; others earn a lump sum of good time by completing programs or holding a prison job, while a few will take any chance to try to escape.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Enough is Enough
A repeat offender smuggles in contraband and an inmate becomes a marked man after murdering a Louisville rap star; a prescription pill epidemic takes its toll on the jail and drug use on the inside could keep another inmate from leaving.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Da Future
With over 2,000 inmates, the Wabash Valley Correctional Facility has a larger population and more acreage than the small town in which it's located; after a decade in confinement, one of Indiana's most infamous inmates moves to general population.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Father Figure
The killer of a corrections officer fights to be freed from 16 years of solitary confinement, and boyhood friends struggle to parent their kids from behind prison walls; but one, cut-off from visits with his son, is on a razor's edge.
